title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
author: Agatha Christie
summary: Captain Hastings, invalided home from the First World War, stays at a country house where the wealthy mistress is poisoned. Belgian refugee Hercule Poirot, in his first appearance, investigates.
readIf: you enjoy classic English country-house puzzles and want to meet Poirot at the start.
skipIf: you want modern pacing or a darker, more psychological crime novel.
